notes.title: Our first update!
notes.content: [p]Hey folks! Chris here, your lead programmer and also now a community guy, I guess.[/p][p][/p][p]First off, a huge thanks to all the friends and family who have downloaded our game, and an even [b][i]BIGGER [/i][/b]thanks to anyone not from our immediate social circle who found the game on Steam and gave it a shot, it means the world.[/p][p][/p][p]Anyways, I'm happy to announce the our first update! The main thing to note is the revamped/rebuilt UI for all of the game's menus, alongside a basic settings menu to adjust things like volume and graphics. The menus were remade using the Unreal CommonUI plugin so they should play a bit nicer with controllers now, though fringe cases are bound to pop up so let me know if you find any.[/p][p]Aside from that there are some smaller tweaks and changes sprinkled throughout, as well as some backend restructuring to make development easier and (hopefully) reduce file sizes. I unfortunately  forgot to keep track of them so I can't really list them out here, I know I added some healing pickups to the boss fight but that's about it. [/p][p]Can't say for sure what will come next or when, I'd like to enhance the tutorial aspects of the game since they aren't very obvious, but we'll see. We have a feedback submission thing in the Discussion forums so please feel free to submit any suggestions or issues you have and I'll take a look.[/p][p][/p][p]That's all for now, and again, thanks to all of you for playing our game. [/p]
